verdict.rationale: WezTerm documents a `wezterm cli` subcommand that talks to a running GUI or multiplexer instance to spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes. A recorded runtime probe ran the full loop headlessly: `spawn --new-window` returned a pane-id, `send-text` delivered text, `get-text` read the pane back, and `list` enumerated windows, tabs and panes. A community user separately confirms using `get-text` to dump scrollback. Missing for 10: the pack holds only a one-line summary of the CLI docs, with no in-depth per-subcommand reference (e.g. flags or output formats for list/get-text).
